items: The finance department delayed reimbursement ____ several receipts were missing from the claim.
'Because' gives the reason reimbursement was delayed.
____ the supplier lowers its minimum order quantity, the retailer will add the product to more stores.
'If' states the condition for wider distribution.
The technician stayed after hours ____ the server migration could be completed before morning.
'So that' introduces the purpose of staying after hours.
The warranty remains valid ____ customers follow the recommended maintenance schedule.
'Provided that' states a condition for the warranty to remain valid.
____ demand increased sharply, the factory maintained its normal delivery schedule.
'Although' introduces a contrast between higher demand and unchanged delivery timing.
The receptionist will notify the visitor ____ the host is ready to meet.
'As soon as' marks the earliest point when the notification will occur.
The company backed up its files nightly ____ data could be restored quickly after an outage.
'So that' introduces the purpose of making nightly backups.
The branch will remain closed ____ the safety inspection has been completed.
'Until' marks the endpoint of the closure.
____ the revised forecast is approved, the sales team can finalize its quarterly targets.
'Once' indicates that target setting can proceed after approval.
The museum extended weekend hours ____ visitor numbers had risen during the summer.
'Because' gives the reason weekend hours were extended.
The procurement portal blocks an order ____ the requested item exceeds the buyer's authorization limit.
'If' states the condition that triggers the block.
The project can proceed ____ the environmental permit is issued before construction begins.
'As long as' states the condition under which the project can proceed.
____ the downtown office is smaller, it accommodates more client meetings than the suburban branch.
'While' introduces a contrast between office size and meeting volume.
The warehouse added a night shift ____ seasonal orders were arriving faster than expected.
'Because' gives the reason a night shift was added.
The application saves a draft automatically ____ the user moves to another section.
'Whenever' means each time the user moves to another section.
The tenant may renew the lease ____ written notice is submitted at least sixty days in advance.
'Provided that' states the condition for renewal.
____ the first shipment arrived late, the remaining deliveries reached the customer on schedule.
'Although' introduces a contrast between the late first shipment and later on-time deliveries.
The laboratory repeated the test ____ the initial readings were inconsistent.
'Because' gives the reason the test was repeated.
The airline sent text alerts ____ passengers would know about the gate change before boarding.
'So that' introduces the purpose of sending text alerts.
The service desk will keep the case open ____ the replacement unit is delivered.
'Until' marks the endpoint for keeping the case open.
____ the client signs the revised agreement, the implementation team will schedule the kickoff meeting.
'Once' marks the point after signing when scheduling can begin.
The cafeteria introduced mobile ordering ____ lunchtime lines had become too long.
'Because' gives the reason mobile ordering was introduced.
Employees must report the incident immediately ____ no customer data appears to have been exposed.
'Even if' shows that reporting is required regardless of whether exposure is apparent.
The contractor may access the site ____ a company supervisor is present.
'Only if' states the necessary condition for site access.
____ the new software offers more features, the accounting team prefers the older version for routine tasks.
'Although' introduces a contrast between greater functionality and user preference.
